body:
Applying for a wholesale account with One Stop Vape Store is straightforward, and the process usually takes a short exchange of emails. This guide walks through each step from the first form to your first delivery, explains what we check and why, what documents help, how quotes and ordering work, how payment is handled, what to expect with shipping and what your responsibilities are once you become a customer. It is written for adults aged 21 and over and for registered retailers. It is general information, not legal advice.

## Before you apply
Make sure you have the basics in order. You should have a registered business, a tax or resale ID and, where your state requires one, a retail license for vapor products. You should sell only to adults aged 21 and over and have a way to verify age. You should have a delivery address that can accept adult-signature parcels and a person who will be there to sign. If any of these is missing, sort it out first, because it will save time and avoid a refusal. Our [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) lists what to prepare.

## Step 1: submit the form
Fill in the form on the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) with your company name, tax or resale ID, contact details, volume estimate and requirements. Say which brands and categories you are interested in, such as disposables, e-liquids, pods or pouches, and roughly how much you expect to buy each month. A saved copy goes to our dashboard, and you receive a confirmation. If you prefer not to use the form, contact us by email, phone or WhatsApp with the same information. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## Step 2: we review
We check your details and may ask for a copy of your business license or proof of age-restricted retail status. This helps us comply with the rules for shipping vape products, and it protects both of us. We may also ask about your location, the products you plan to sell and how you verify age. A review is routine, and most applications that are complete are handled promptly. If we cannot supply a business, for example because we cannot ship lawfully to its location, we explain why.

### Documents that help
- **Business license or registration.**
- **Tax or resale certificate.**
- **State or local tobacco or vapor retail license,** where one applies.
- **Proof of the shop address,** such as a utility bill or a lease.
- **A contact who can sign for deliveries.**

## Step 3: receive a quote
We reply with product availability and volume pricing for the items you listed. You can negotiate quantities and mix products. The quote states the products, options such as strength and pack size, quantities, unit prices, total, shipping and any discounts that apply. Check it carefully, and ask us to change anything that is not right. Do not pay until you have a quote you are happy with, in writing.

## Step 4: place the order
Place the order through the website cart or by agreement with our team, depending on size. Smaller trade orders often work through the cart, with options chosen on each product page. Larger orders are arranged with us, and we confirm the details in writing. Large orders may be reviewed for accuracy and compliance before shipping, which is routine for wholesale volumes. We confirm the order, the total and the expected processing time.

## Step 5: pay
Choose a payment method with our team. See [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) for fees and speed. Cryptocurrency, especially stablecoins, handles large payments well and is matched automatically on most networks. Gift cards and app payments suit smaller amounts because of limits. We confirm which method is best for the size of your order. Follow the matching guide, for example [paying with USDC on Solana](/blog/pay-with-usdc-on-solana/) or [USDT ERC20 vs TRC20](/blog/usdt-erc20-vs-trc20-which-network/), and send your proof if we ask. Orders begin processing once payment is confirmed.

## Step 6: receive and resell responsibly
Parcels arrive with adult-signature delivery, and the carrier checks government-issued photo ID. Plan for someone to be present. Check the delivery against your invoice as soon as it arrives, photograph any damage and tell us the same day. You are responsible for local licensing and age checks on your own sales. Learn more in [state and local vape laws explained](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/), [the PACT Act explained](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) and [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/).

## How long does it take?
A complete application can be reviewed within a few business days, and a quote follows soon after. The longest delays come from missing documents, so send everything with your first message. After you pay, orders process within 24 to 72 business hours, and carriers take 3 to 7 business days to the West Coast or 11 to 18 business days to the eastern half of the US. Plan your first order with those lead times in mind.

## After your first order
Once you are set up, reordering is quicker, because we already have your details. Tell us how your first order sold, and we can suggest quantities for next time. If you want to add products, send a list. If you want regular deliveries, tell us your schedule. Keep records of your purchases and invoices for your own bookkeeping and for any inspection you may face as a retailer.

## Common questions
### Do I need a physical shop?
We supply registered retailers. If you sell online or through another lawful channel, tell us how, and we will say whether we can supply you. Remote sellers must follow the rules for remote sales.

### Can individuals buy wholesale?
Wholesale is for businesses. Individuals can use the regular store, where the 10% discount for cryptocurrency and gift cards applies and bulk buying still lowers your cost per item. See [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/).

### Is there a fee to open an account?
We do not describe any account fee. Pricing is in the quote, and we confirm everything before you pay.

### What if my application is declined?
We explain the reason where we can. If it is a documentation issue, you can resubmit with the missing items.

### Can I get samples?
Ask us. Sample availability depends on the products, and sample packs cannot be partially returned if opened.

## Staying in touch
Keep your contact details current, and tell us if your address, license or business details change. Contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with any question. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) to build your list. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Common reasons applications are delayed
- **Missing tax or resale ID.** Include it in the first message.
- **No retail license where one is required.** Check your state's rules and attach it.
- **An address that cannot accept signature deliveries.** Give a street address with staff present.
- **An unclear product list.** List brands, flavors and quantities, even roughly.
- **Mismatched names.** Use the same business name on the form, the documents and the delivery address.

Fixing these before you apply saves days. A short checklist next to the form helps you remember everything.

## A sample first message
"Hello, I run [shop name] in [city, state]. Our business is registered as [legal name], resale ID [number], and I have attached our retail license. We would like to stock disposables from [brands], e-liquid from [brands] and pouches from [brands]. Our expected monthly volume is about [amount]. Our delivery address is [address], and [name] will sign for deliveries with ID. Please send availability and volume pricing." A message like this answers almost every question we would ask.

## Building the relationship
The best wholesale relationships are built on clear communication. Tell us early if your needs change, flag problems promptly and keep your documents current. We, in turn, tell you about availability, changes that affect your area and anything we need from you. Treat it as a partnership: the smoother it runs, the easier it is to scale your orders as your shop grows.

## Frequently asked questions about onboarding
### What happens to my documents?
They are used only to confirm that your business can lawfully buy and resell vapor products, and they are handled under our [privacy policy](/privacy/). Send copies, not originals, and tell us if you would like us to delete them after review, subject to legal record-keeping requirements.

### Can several people from my business order?
Yes. Tell us who is authorized to place orders and who will receive deliveries, and we will note it against the account so there is no confusion.

### What if I run more than one shop?
Tell us the details of each, because licenses, addresses and tax IDs may differ. Each location receives its own deliveries, and we can discuss how to organize orders.

## A short checklist before you press submit
1. Business name matches your documents.
2. Tax or resale ID included.
3. Retail license attached where required.
4. Delivery address can accept adult-signature parcels.
5. Product list and rough quantities included.
6. A contact name, email and phone number that you answer.

With those six items in your first message, a review is usually quick, and you can move on to the quote.
